analysis: Proposal revision recovery across process restart v1
interpretation: A producer process writes graph, grammar, rule store, IDs, and partial revision state; a distinct process restores exact graph/grammar/rules, resumes missing stages, commits, and awakens the guarded consumer.
limits: Clean process boundary only; no injected OS kill, power loss, or torn write.
No schema migration, concurrent writer, in-closure failure atomicity, or universal consumer enforcement.
JSON checkpoints are fsync'ed on this local filesystem; no general hardware durability guarantee.
